text:
Silver Price in 2012
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2012, the LBMA silver price fell 10.9% between 2012-01-31 ($33.60) and 2012-12-31 ($29.95). The highest sampled price was $37.23 in February and the lowest was $27.08 in June. The mean of these observations was $31.63. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
